title: Mathesis quiz questions
description: The file written by the Udemy userscript's "Save all as JSON" button: every question of one quiz attempt. It says nothing about what you answered or got wrong.

title.description: Quiz title, as in the course curriculum.

author.description: The course's instructor(s) as Udemy shows them, comma-separated; empty when the page does not say. Absent in files saved before it was recorded.

attempt.description: "Attempt 2", or empty when the page does not show it.

source.description: URL of the results page the questions were read from.

timeLimitMinutes.description: The exam's time limit in minutes, when the page says it (Udemy has no field for it: it is read from sentences such as "50-60 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours" in the course description), otherwise null.

timeLimitText.description: The sentence the time limit was read from, empty when timeLimitMinutes is null.

number.description: Position in the attempt, or null when the page does not show it.

domain.description: Exam domain label, empty when the quiz has none.

type.description: "multi" when more than one option is correct.

explanation.description: Overall explanation of the question (Markdown). Empty when the quiz explains each option instead.

text.description: The option text, as one line of Markdown.

explanation.description: Why this option is right or wrong (Markdown). Empty when the quiz only has an overall explanation.
